scenario.narrative: Weather at DAL (59 min weather delay in the DOT row) cuts the arrival rate from 44 to 24/hr with turbulence on final.

messages.reason: S04-A2 and S04-A3 both land at t=4.0 with window_load 0.29 and knock_on_min 1.2, well under the 24/hr cap, while DIVERT-ACT adds cost 8.0 with no arrival-rate benefit. Wake margin is 5.01 min on the landing options.
red_lines: Do not exceed the 24/hr weather-reduced arrival cap
Do not sequence any landing that reduces wake separation below validator minimum
Do not use runway 27L slots that conflict with taxiway K block on gates A7 and A8 before 27.6

messages.reason: Both LAND options hold 0 min with 15.1 min fuel margin and 0.5 turbulence, missing 10 pax, while DIVERT-ACT strands 42 pax and burns 1216 kg extra fuel for 19.1 min margin.
